transcript.speaker: David Kim
transcript.text: Welcome team to the Q3 Infrastructure Architecture review. Today we need to align on our zero-trust API gateway transition.

transcript.speaker: Elena Rostova
transcript.text: I analyzed our traffic logs. We decided to approve the zero-trust architecture rollout for production API gateways immediately.

transcript.speaker: Elena Rostova
transcript.text: Elena Rostova will complete the mTLS certificate proxy deployment by 04:00 PM today.

transcript.speaker: David Kim
transcript.text: I think we should immediately deprecate all IPv4 legacy endpoints to cut infrastructure costs.

transcript.speaker: Elena Rostova
transcript.text: I strongly disagree with deprecating IPv4 immediately because over 15 percent of enterprise mobile clients still rely on IPv4 routes.

transcript.speaker: David Kim
transcript.text: There is a risk that legacy mobile SDK versions could experience latency spikes during the mTLS certificate rotation.
